## Purpose and Entry Points
PPT Master is an agent-driven, local Python workflow for turning prompts or source documents into natively editable `.pptx` presentations. It is not a hosted application: an AI agent reads workflow instructions, writes project artifacts, and invokes scripts.
- Core agent contract: `skills/ppt-master/SKILL.md`
- Workflow router and generation flow: `skills/ppt-master/workflows/routing.md`, `skills/ppt-master/workflows/generate-pptx.md`
- Python dependencies: `requirements.txt`, `skills/ppt-master/requirements.txt`

## Workflow Orchestration and Project State
The skill defines staged work rather than a single executable entry point. Project workspaces preserve intermediate artifacts so an agent can plan, execute, inspect, and resume. The normal route establishes a design specification and lock before slide production; quick generation intentionally skips durable planning and preview finalization.
- Project management CLI/spec model: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/project_management/cli.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/project_specs.py`
- Stage contracts: `skills/ppt-master/workflows/stages/refine-spec.md`, `skills/ppt-master/workflows/stages/resume-execute.md`
- Reusable schemas: `skills/ppt-master/templates/schemas/design_spec.schema.json`, `skills/ppt-master/templates/schemas/spec_lock.schema.json`

## Source Intake, Research, and Content Design
Input may be pasted content or local files placed under `projects/`. Source conversion normalizes documents into Markdown; the agent then structures narrative, selects a presentation mode/style/template, and plans slide-level content and visual assets. This is a reasoning boundary: the LLM owns interpretation and authoring decisions, while scripts provide deterministic conversion and validation.
- Multi-format conversion dispatcher: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/source_to_md/_dispatcher.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/source_to_md/pdf_to_md.py`
- Strategist guidance: `skills/ppt-master/references/strategist.md`, `skills/ppt-master/references/strategist-template.md`
- Workspace examples and expected artifacts: `examples/ppt169_attention_is_all_you_need/design_spec.md`, `examples/ppt169_attention_is_all_you_need/spec_lock.md`

## Visual Authoring and Asset Acquisition
Slides are first authored as SVG in a project’s `svg_output/`, using shared visual standards, template references, images, icons, charts, and formulas. `finalize_svg.py` produces self-contained `svg_final/` previews and postprocesses embedded/cropped assets. SVG is the principal editable layout interchange boundary before PowerPoint packaging.
- SVG finalization pipeline: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/finalize_svg.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_finalize/`
- SVG quality contracts/checker: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_quality/checker.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_quality/svg_contracts.py`
- Visual/template catalogs: `skills/ppt-master/templates/styles/styles_index.json`, `skills/ppt-master/templates/layouts/layouts_index.json`

Images can come from user files, AI-generation backends, or searchable web providers. External calls are confined to configured model/image APIs; attribution handling is explicit.
- Generation facade/backends: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/image_gen.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/image_backends/`
- Search facade/providers: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/image_search.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/image_sources/`

## Native PPTX Export and Enhancement
The main exporter converts SVG geometry and text into native DrawingML, then assembles an OOXML PPTX package. Default charts/tables are editable SVG-derived shapes; an optional route replaces eligible groups with native data-backed PowerPoint chart/table objects. A separate template-fill path preserves an existing deck’s masters/layouts while filling its semantic slots.
- Export entry and converter: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_to_pptx.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_to_pptx/drawingml/converter.py`
- OOXML package construction: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_to_pptx/pptx_package/builder.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_to_pptx/native_objects/`
- Template preservation/fill route: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/template_fill_pptx.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/template_fill_pptx/applier.py`

Post-export capabilities add or validate native animations, transitions, speaker notes, narration, and delivery correctness.
- Animation/transition modules: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/pptx_animations.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/pptx_transitions.py`
- Narration/audio: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/notes_to_audio.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/tts_backends/`
- Delivery validation: `skills/ppt-master/scripts/pptx_delivery_check.py`, `skills/ppt-master/scripts/pptx_opc_validation.py`

## Runtime, Integrations, and Distribution
Runtime is Python 3.10+ on the user machine; agent-capable tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI supply the LLM control plane. `.env` supplies optional API keys for image and TTS providers. PowerPoint is the target consumer, while static example browsing is deployed through GitHub Pages.
- Environment example: `.env.example`, `skills/ppt-master/.env.example`
- Claude plugin distribution: `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `skills/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
- Static viewer/site entry points: `index.html`, `viewer.html`, `.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml`
